prompt:
This file is prompt-only policy for Seed skills. Use shell, jq, and edit. Internal identifiers and metadata are English-only. Follow https://agentskills.io/specification: one skill is one directory containing SKILL.md; frontmatter has exactly one name and one non-empty description.

ROOTS
Install-scoped: <install>/agent-store/seed-agent/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
Workspace-scoped: $PWD/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
Inspect only bounded visible roots. Do not copy a body into the Machine index and do not register a parent directory. Reject symlink escapes.

REGISTRATION
Register metadata in Machine index agent.skills as {name,description,path,ok,note,source}. path is the SKILL.md file, not its directory. ok true requires readable valid frontmatter whose name matches the directory slug; directory readability alone is insufficient. Preserve unrelated and experience-owned rows. A name collision never overwrites an existing ok row.

WRITES
Every Machine-index mutation holds agent-store/.state.lock. Claim with mkdir, write owner PID, perform one complete read-modify-write through a unique same-directory validated temporary file and rename, then release. Never clear or rebuild the whole skill array.

COMMAND
For /skills, list name, description, ok, and source from agent.skills. Enable or disable changes only the matching owned row under the shared lock.

CHECKS
1) Both skill roots exist.
2) At least one SKILL.md has valid frontmatter.
3) agent.skills has one matching {name,path,ok:true}; path names that SKILL.md file.
4) No unrelated or experience row changed.
If any check fails, leave ours.seed_agent.skills unset.
